content.summary: The Arvada Reservoir Ranger program seeks volunteers for the 2026 season to assist with operations at the Arvada-Blunn Reservoir, including guest assistance, safety patrols, and event support. Applicants must be 18 or older, pass a background check, and possess strong interpersonal skills. content.body:
![Four Reservoir Ranger volunteers pose beside a utility vehicle along the shoreline of a reseroir](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7005 "Four Reservoir Ranger volunteers pose beside a utility vehicle along the shoreline of a reseroir")

## Program Overview

Arvada Reservoir Rangers are a dedicated group of volunteers who assist with the daily operations of the [Arvada-Blunn Reservoir](/658). Reservoir Rangers provide guest assistance, first aid, emergency response and resource protection to enhance the experience of all reservoir visitors.

## Apply now to be a Reservoir Ranger

The City is always looking for new volunteers to join the Arvada Reservoir Ranger program for the 2026 season!

**We are actively looking for volunteers who can work during the weekends only.**

The seasonal position runs from April through October. Applications are accepted year-round.

[Join Today](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32098)

### Duties

- Perform boat and kayak inspections
- Respond to visitor concerns in a friendly and receptive manner
- Patrol reservoir for safety concerns
- Provide general information for reservoir usage to visitors
- Assist at special events such as the annual Arvada Kids Fishing Tournament
- Sell daily and annual passes to the reservoir
- View the full [Reservoir Ranger job description (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/609)
- [Reservoir Ranger Application](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32098)

### Requirements

- 18 years of age or older
- Clean background check
- Strong people skills and friendly demeanor
- Ability to educate the public about park rules in a non-confrontational manner

### Perks, Benefits & Incentives

- Free admission to Arvada Reservoir for the entire season
- Uniforms provided: Ranger t-shirt, hat and hooded jacket
- End-of-season celebration / banquet that includes great food and music

### Awards Program

- 400+ hours served: Lifetime reservoir pass
- 600+ hours served: Engraved Spyderco pocket knife
- 1,000+ hours served: Heavy Ranger jacket
- 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 hours served: Special Ranger pin

### Annual End-of-Season Rangers Banquet
